_note: Third-party brand marks committed for the AI Top 5 story-background logo tier. resolveLogo() maps a story's entities[] to one of these; a name with no entry resolves to null and the background falls back to a plain gradient. ONLY marks a shipped edition actually renders are listed. This was eleven entries: ten of them were speculative, downloaded to every clone against the chance that a future edition might name that company, and rendered by nothing. Simple Icons publishes the FILES under CC0, but a company trademark is not CC0 and is not covered by this repository's MIT licence, so shipping marks on the off-chance is a cost with no benefit. Add one back only when an edition displays it; scripts/vendor-logos.mjs fetches it.
